combo_label: The Sunday Roast × Perfume & Scent × The Blitz

entries.clue: Paste from a cat-like animal's gland, nowadays made up in a laboratory.
Scored pork skin gone glassy and salty under searing heat
Dry wood note smelling much like freshly sharpened pencils.
The merest touch of scent, pressed on with a single fingertip.
To float across a room on moving air, as a good smell does.
Alchemist's domed copper still, its name reaching English from Arabic.
Very lean beef joint off the hind leg, sold with a cap of fat tied round it
Rubber respirator issued to every civilian against an attack that never came
Letters on a warden's badge, standing for air raid precautions
Familiar name for the crisp potatoes done in the fat round the meat
Device whose rising and falling wail sent a street down to the shelters
Civilian rostered from 1941 to watch a business roof for incendiaries
Creamy-white root, sweeter than a carrot when its edges catch
